comment: The GDHCN description correctly separates trust from personal content, but it may imply that the network alone establishes end-to-end trustworthiness. Document authenticity does not establish clinical accuracy, issuer competence, holder identity, current validity, or legal acceptability.

public.text: The GDHCN description correctly separates trust from personal content, but it may imply that the network alone establishes end-to-end trustworthiness. Document authenticity does not establish clinical accuracy, issuer competence, holder identity, current validity, or legal acceptability.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that GDHCN supports verification of issuer trust and document integrity. Relying parties must also evaluate document type, validity, subject binding, clinical meaning, revocation status, policy, and applicable law.
